Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A chemical engineer and a janitor were talking about how they ended up in the jobs they did. The chemical engineer recalled having a hard time before college, even not passing some classes, and the janitor started their story talking about having been a member of the honors society back in high school. Who did very well in high school?
A. Cannot be determined
B. The chemical engineer
C. The janitor
